name: Expression
description: Works out a formula over up to six values, a to f (numbers or booleans). Operators: + - * / % ** (power), == != < > <= >=, and or not, and x if c else y. Functions: round floor ceil abs min max clamp sqrt pow log log2 log10 sin cos tan. Also true, false and pi. A comparison, and, or and not give a boolean; a boolean counts as 1 or 0 in arithmetic and a number is true unless it is 0. Dividing by zero, the log of a value of 0 or less and a result beyond 1e15 are errors. An input that is not connected is an error only when the formula reaches it.

inputs.name: formula
inputs.label: Formula
inputs.description: For example a * 2 + 1, a > 1024 and b, or clamp(a / b, 0, 1).

outputs.name: number
outputs.label: Number
outputs.description: The result as a number; a boolean result is 1 or 0.

outputs.name: boolean
outputs.label: Boolean
outputs.description: The result as a boolean: true unless it is 0.
